title: The quotient stack of a smooth groupoid in algebraic spaces is an algebraic stack

core_obligations: Condition (1): [U/R] is a stack in groupoids by construction (quotient stack construction).
Condition (2): the diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces via the stronger diagonal lemma.

Condition (3): choose W -> U surjective etale from a scheme; S_W -> S_U is surjective etale (presheaf transfer, then the implication lemma); compose with S_U -> [U/R] surjective smooth (carded lemma) and the composition lemma.
proof_roadmap: Stack property by construction; diagonal condition; composed presentation construction.
difficulty_reason: A three-definition-condition check whose last condition is a composed presentation construction.
